Магний.about: Cofactor of 300+ enzymes: muscles, nerves, sleep. The effect and tolerability depend on the form.
Магний.caution: Magnesium is an essential mineral. For arterial hypertension: Cochrane (16856052) confirms a decrease in pressure (especially if there is an initial deficiency). For type 2 diabetes: meta-analyses show improvement in HbA1c and insulin resistance. For seizures during pregnancy: data available. For migraine: there is data outside the database. Form matters: citrate/glycinate/malate is better than oxide. Dose: 200-400 mg/day. Caution: renal failure, bradycardia.
Магний.course: constantly when there is a shortage
Магний.food_sources: Pumpkin seeds, almonds, buckwheat, dark chocolate, leafy greens.
Магний.guidelines: EFSA: muscle and nervous system function; NIH: deficiency more common after age 70.
Магний.how_to_choose: Citrate, glycinate, bisglycinate - absorption and tolerability; oxide is cheap, poorly absorbed, weakens.

interactions.note: reduces absorption, separate doses for 2-4 hours

Магний.myths: “Calms immediately” - the effect is cumulative. “Either form is the same” - the oxide barely raises levels.
